purpose: Herblore XP ladder + ironman supply for Equilibrium
verification_notes: No invented XP/h. Rates below are wiki-published figures from Herblore training and Ironman Mode/Guide/Herblore (fetched 2026-07-26). Where the guide only lists XP per potion, xp_rate is left null with a freshness warning.
Pay-to-play Herblore training redirects to Herblore training on the wiki.
Equilibrium region IDs: forinthry = Daemonheim/Wilderness peninsula; City of Um uses misthalin working taxonomy; Flash Powder Factory is Asgarnia (Rogues' Den / Taverley).
Telekinetic Grind harralander tar already exists in training-high-value.json (~3.9m XP/h). This file improves notes and multi-region supply; does not invent a lower rate.

methods.location: Druidic Ritual (Asgarnia) then Jungle Potion (Karamja automatic-early), Recruitment Drive (Asgarnia), The Dig Site (Misthalin)
methods.notes: Herblore training guide lists these quests as the clean 1-19 path before potions or tar. Prefer putting other XP rewards into Herblore on ironman/league (ironman guide).
methods.warning: No XP/h for quest XP; treat as unlock ladder only.

methods.location: Any bank; herbs from farming patches, bosses, Miscellania, Temple Trekking, slayer
methods.notes: Cleaning is the first half of every ironman potion chain. Factory full-set unfinished-potion path grants cleaning-equivalent XP when making unfinished potions (see factory outfit). Ironman guide prioritises useful potions over pure clean-for-XP.
methods.warning: Wiki does not publish a single clean-herbs XP/h for the main ladder; leave blank rather than invent.

methods.method: Unfinished potions (herb + vial of water / coconut milk)
methods.location: Any bank; portable well worlds for +10% XP and 5% extra unfinished when available
methods.notes: Fastest GE ladder uses pre-bought unfinished. Ironman must make them. Full factory outfit: unfinished potions grant XP equivalent to cleaning the herb. Scroll of cleansing: 10% chance to save the herb when making unfinished. Modified botanist's mask: prefer when making unfinished for 5% extra potions (XP per action is 1, so small XP mods need 10%+ to matter).
methods.warning: No single unfinished XP/h on the training guide; throughput is inventory/bank-speed bound.

methods.method: Early finished potions ladder (attack / strength / energy / prayer)
methods.location: Any bank; portable well for +10% XP when available
methods.notes: Wiki fastest 1-99 alternative path XP per potion (from unfinished + secondary): Attack 25 XP (lvl 1, guam + eye of newt); Strength 40 XP (tarromin + limpwurt); Energy 67.5 XP (harralander + chocolate dust); Prayer 87.5 XP (ranarr + snape grass). Ironman recommended uses: guam attack or burner; tarromin Serum 207 or burner; harralander cooking/energy potion or tar; ranarr always prayer potions.
methods.warning: Guide does not publish XP/h for these bands; only XP/potion. No-trading League throughput is herb/secondary limited.

methods.method: Mid finished potions ladder (super attack / super restore / super ranging / sara brew)
methods.location: Any bank; portable well preferred
methods.notes: Wiki XP per potion on the main ladder: Super attack 125 XP (irit + limpwurt); Super restore 142.5 XP (snapdragon + red spiders' eggs); Super ranging 162.5 XP (dwarf weed + wine of zamorak); Saradomin brew 180 XP (toadflax + crushed nest) to 88. Ironman guide: irit super attack or super antipoison; toadflax sara brew; keep high herbs for extremes/overloads where possible.
methods.warning: No XP/h for mid ladder on wiki; XP/potion only. Secondary bottlenecks (crushed nests, wine of zamorak, eggs) dominate ironman pace.

methods.location: Any bank; portable well + dose/outfit stack
methods.notes: Wiki XP per extreme (highest-level extreme for speed): Extreme attack 220 (88, super attack + avantoe); Extreme strength 230 (89, super strength + dwarf weed); Extreme defence 240 (90, super defence + lantadyme); Extreme magic 250 (91, super magic + ground mud runes); Extreme ranging 260 (92, super ranging + 5 grenwall spikes); Extreme necromancy 265 (93, super necromancy + ground miasma rune). Guide: always brew the highest unlockable extreme for max XP/h among extremes.
methods.warning: No absolute XP/h listed for extremes; only XP/potion. Ironman must bank super potions first.

methods.intensity: high material cost; medium click intensity
methods.location: Any bank; Herblore master cape batch at 120 Herblore (master cape perk)
methods.notes: Base overload at 96: all six extreme (3) + clean torstol; 1,000 base XP / 1,100 with portable well per wiki table. Guide 96-99 example: 3,000 overloads ~3.0m base XP, ~3.6m with 20% portable+pulse. Untradeable - ironman must self-make for use. Higher chain (salves, supreme, elder) uses Meilyr combination recipes and/or primal extract - see combination and primal methods. Master cape: batch 5 overloads/elder from ingredients of 4; supreme overload 4 from ingredients of 3.
methods.warning: No standalone overload XP/h on guide (material-limited). GE cost example on page is mainscape only.

methods.method: Combination potions (Meilyr Recipe Shop + crystal flasks)
methods.level_range: 75-99+ (recipe-dependent; no level req to buy recipes)
methods.xp_rate: Grand-style combinations over 350,000 XP/h with constant focus; Super melee over 450,000 XP/h; Super warmaster's over 720,000 XP/h (wiki Other methods).
methods.intensity: very high click intensity; short inventories
methods.location: Meilyr district, Prifddinas (Recipe Shop + Meilyr Voice of Seren hour for +20% combo XP); crystal flasks from Prif crafting
methods.notes: Plague's End unlocks combination potions. All recipes purchased from Meilyr Recipe Shop (100k-1.5m each; 15.2m for all). Nine recipes also need Daemonheim unreadable pages (or 100k tokens each) - Forinthry dependency for those pages. Grand ranging/magic/strength/defence and super prayer renewal: no unreadable page. Meilyr hour + perfect juju herblore/perfect plus (+5% on 6-dose combos) + full botanist outfit is the ironman ideal combo setup. Scroll of cleansing treats every component potion as a secondary (10% save on each) - nearly mandatory for ironman cost. Portable well: +10% XP only, no extra potion on combinations.
methods.warning: XP/h figures are lower-bound wiki phrasing ('over X'); exact rates depend on banking speed and recipe. Untradeable combos often worse than extremes for training cost.
methods.multi_region_combo_note: Tirannwn for shop/crystal flasks/Meilyr hour; Forinthry/Daemonheim for unreadable-page recipes (super melee, super warmaster, many overload variants).

methods.method: Primal fruit pulp to primal extract
methods.xp_rate: Wiki GE path (pulp bought, extract only): 355,250 XP/h (90-101), 297,250 (102-111), 261,000 (112-120). Ironman guide including pulp-making time: 312,109.3 / 266,684.9 / 237,378.9 XP/h for the same bands.
methods.location: Bank standing for extract; fruit from Farming bushes/fruit trees/cacti (lychee, carambola, golden dragonfruit) requiring 95+ Farming to start the fruit path
methods.notes: 90 Herblore + 90 Cooking to make pulp; 90 Herblore to vial into primal extract. Ironman: full fruit run ~488 pulp base / ~70,760 Herblore XP in extract; with wolpertinger, giant ent, master farmer, Bountiful Harvest ~1,095 pulp / ~158,775 Herblore XP plus large Farming XP; full run every 6h (trees/cacti regrow 2h). Extract is the high-end ingredient for elder overloads, bombs, powerbursts.
methods.warning: Do not mix GE-path XP/h with ironman pulp-inclusive XP/h; they measure different loops.

methods.method: Weapon poison+++ (ironman high-level alternative to pure pulp)
methods.intensity: farm-run + gathering; less tedious than pure pulp past 102 per ironman guide
methods.location: Bush/fruit tree patches + Skavid caves (cave nightshade) + Anachronia Dinosaur Farm frogs for poison slime
methods.notes: Ironman guide: less daily XP than max pulp but less tedious after 102. Optimal average gather cited: 45 poison ivy, 52.5 coconut, 16.5 carambola, 10.35 golden dragonfruit for ~81,798.5 Herblore XP and ~38,291 Farming XP per cycle. Poison slime from raising frogs on Anachronia farm (150 beans per 270 slime).
methods.warning: Wiki gives per-cycle XP, not XP/h; do not invent hourly rate.

methods.method: High-end bombs and powerbursts (primal extract products)
methods.location: Bank standing; secondaries heavily Anachronia farm/dinosaur (poison slime, beak snot, dinosaur claws, bottled dinosaur roar)
methods.notes: Wiki fastest 99-120 alternative path XP each: Poison bomb 950 (irit + primal extract + 2 poison slime + weapon poison++ (4)); Sticky bomb 1,000 (cadantine + primal extract + beak snot/dinosaur claws); Vulnerability bomb 1,100 (dwarf weed + primal extract + runes + bottled dinosaur roar); Powerburst of feats 1,600 (snapdragon + primal extract + summoning potion (3) + bottled dinosaur roar). Primary training page positions these as non-tar alternatives to 120.
methods.warning: No XP/h published for bomb/powerburst banks; only XP per product and potion counts to level milestones.

methods.xp_rate: Roughly 140,000 XP/h (wiki Herblore training Other methods)
methods.intensity: low AFK; stackable swamp tar allows up to 27 herbs per inventory
methods.location: Any bank; 1 clean harralander + 15 swamp tar = 15 tar for 72.5 Herblore XP
methods.notes: Slower tar method. Tarromin tar is 25% less XP. Swamp tar stackable. Does not benefit from scroll of cleansing (scroll does not apply to herb tars).

methods.level_range: 44 Herblore + 85 Magic; Lunar Diplomacy for Lunar spellbook (tar fastest from 19+ once spell unlocked)
methods.xp_rate: Roughly 3,900,000 Herblore XP/h (wiki high-speed Telekinetic Grind example for harralander tar)
methods.location: Bank standing with Lunar spellbook; spell unlock Fremennik (Lunar Isle / Lunar Diplomacy)
methods.notes: Already seeded in training-high-value.json. Wiki: Telekinetic Grind on full inventory ~3.9m Herblore XP/h depending on banking speed. Fastest Herblore XP method at any level once available. Upfront swamp tar + harralander volume is extreme. Swamp tar major ground supply: Lumbridge Swamp (Misthalin starting). Astral + law runes per cast. Improve vs high-value row: call out pestle baseline 140k for comparison; scroll of cleansing does not apply to tar; GE buy limits (20k swamp tar / 4h) are mainscape-only pressure - league/ironman is pure gather.
methods.warning: Extremely resource-hungry. GE assumptions on the training page do not transfer to no-trading League. Do not invent rates below 3.9m for the telekinetic path; if supply cannot support it, fall back to pestle ~140k or potion ladder.
methods.multi_region_combo_note: Fremennik for Lunar/Telekinetic Grind unlock; Misthalin Lumbridge Swamp for bulk swamp tar. Herb supply is multi-region farming/bossing.

methods.method: Flash Powder Factory - botanist's and factory outfits
methods.level_range: 50 Herblore; 75 Thieving and 75 Agility to enter factory (unboostable)
methods.intensity: minigame for outfit unlock; then passive worn boosts
methods.location: Flash Powder Factory / Rogues' Den under Pick and Lute, Taverley
methods.notes: Botanist's outfit: 1% Herblore XP per piece + 1% set = 6% full. Modified botanist's mask: +1% XP and 5% chance to duplicate potions (no extra XP on duplicate). Factory outfit: 3/5 pieces = 10% chance 4-dose instead of 3-dose (stacks with Morytania legs 4 / Desert amulet 4 on specific potions); full 5/5 unfinished-potion XP equal to cleaning the herb. Ironman optimized mix often: modified mask + selected factory pieces for dose economy rather than one full set always. Prefer Minigame Spotlight for thaler if buying via thaler.
methods.warning: Unlock XP/h not published; this row is outfit infrastructure, not a primary XP method.

methods.intensity: permanent unlock; passive during potion making
methods.location: Daemonheim Rewards (Marmaros); 20,000 Dungeoneering tokens
methods.notes: 12.5% chance to mix twice as fast; 10% chance to save secondary when adding herb to vial/coconut milk or secondary to unfinished (also juju, combination, extreme). Effect is global after unlock. Does not apply to herb tars or cups of tea; does not save the vial/flask base. Strongest relative value on multi-ingredient combination potions.
methods.warning: Purchase geography is Daemonheim (Equilibrium forinthry). Not a Wilderness drop.

methods.intensity: storage QoL; weekly D&D for spirit points
methods.location: Ancient Zygomite elder / Herby Werby Reward Shop, Anachronia
methods.notes: 200 spirit points base (50 of each grimy herb); +200 upgrade to 100 each. Auto-stores unnoted grimy pickups and most herb-patch harvests while carried. Works with upgraded Herbicide auto-collect into bag. Primary ironman/league inventory tool for herb logistics - not an XP method by itself.

methods.location: Ancient Zygomites' cavern, Anachronia
methods.notes: Stop zygomites with healthy/green herbs for Herblore XP; burning corrupt flora is Firemaking. Max 100 points weekly. Outfit, pulse cores, DXB apply. Spirit points fund herb bag.
methods.warning: No single XP/h published for a Herblore-maxed run; weekly points-capped.

methods.level_range: post-Extinction; station build uses base camp resources
methods.xp_rate: 350,000 XP/h while withdrawing stored station XP
methods.intensity: very AFK withdraw; restock with Anachronia base camp leaves
methods.location: Dream of Iaia apothecary (Extinction)
methods.notes: Build costs 50k of each Anachronia base camp resource; awards 135k XP stored + 15k direct. Restock: 2 leaves = 1 stored XP; max store 350k. AFK Herblore sink after Extinction.

methods.xp_rate: Equivalent rate if finished in 5 minutes: 5,940 XP/h at level 1 up to 582,180 XP/h at level 99 (10 goebie supplies; 495-48,515 raw XP)
methods.location: Mazcab Kanatah supply rock to Otot (Nemi Forest); skill choice Farming or Herblore on offered worlds
methods.notes: Up to 10 goebie supplies/day. Safe PvP flag while carrying supplies. Logging out/hopping deletes carried supplies.
methods.warning: Mazcab region mapping for Equilibrium electives may need planner confirmation; treat as multi_region until locality rule is fixed.

methods.level_range: Dungeoneering token purchase; toolbelt via 500 slayer points
methods.location: Daemonheim Rewards purchase (34,000 tokens); effect global
methods.notes: Destroys dropped herbs in combat for double clean XP. Slow primary training; good passive on slayer. Tool belt unlock 500 slayer points.
methods.warning: Guide calls this quite slow; no XP/h published.

methods.method: Efficiency stack note - scroll + herb bag + botanist/factory (+ Meilyr combos)
methods.intensity: planner stack, not a single activity
methods.location: Cross-region unlocks used at any bank / Meilyr for combos
methods.notes: Optimized no-trade Herblore pulls Forinthry (scroll of cleansing), Anachronia (herb bag + farm produce), Asgarnia (Flash Powder Factory outfits), and Tirannwn (Meilyr recipes, crystal flasks, Voice of Seren). Planner should treat these as a linked stack, not isolated optional cosmetics.
methods.warning: Not an XP method; multi-region dependency edge for the planner.

supply_routes.notes: Core ironman herb spine. Standard patches include Falador south (Asgarnia), Port Phasmatys west (Morytania), Catherby north (Kandarin), plus others on the farming loop. Bloodweed and fellstalk are farming-primary per ironman herb table. Garden of Kharid (Desert) permanent upgrades (Bountiful Harvest, Speedy Growth) amplify yields.
